title: Jacobian criterion for smoothness of a relative global complete intersection at a prime
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $n,c\ge0$ integers and $f_1,\dots,f_c\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] such that $S=R[x_1,\dots,x_n]/(f_1,\dots,f_c)$ is a relative global complete intersection [def-weil-pbc-relative-global-complete-intersection]. For a subset $I\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\}$ of cardinality $c$ let $g_I=\det(\partial f_j/\partial x_i)_{j=1,\dots,c,\ i\in I}\in R[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ [def-weil-pbc-polynomial-partial-derivative] and $\bar g_I\in S$ its image. Let $\mathfrak q\subset S$ be a prime ideal. Then $R\to S$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] if and only if there is a subset $I\subseteq\{1,\dots,n\}$ with $|I|=c$ and $\bar g_I\notin\mathfrak q$.
